text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document 
outlines the major maintenance procedures P1, which must be carried out from 
three to six years as indicated by Y3:6 in the title block
This 
procedure was applied in Damanhour Thermal Power Plant3*65mw since 1976. The generator data: 
81.25MVA, 10.5KV, 4.45KA, PF=0.8, 50HZ, 3000 rpm, Y connection
The first draft initiated by eng. 
Mohamed Fatehy AboElkher, tested by eng.Samir 
Ouf Hassoub , accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam, 
approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour power station, 
and certified by eng. Sania Diab Attia Diab WDEPC inspection head sector and 
MPIS coordinator.
Safety 
Precautions
Work order must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should the suitable safety 
 category.
Safety fence (rope) 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear safety helmet, 
 shoes, gloves ... etc.
Gas turbine out of 
 service at cold state.
Tools and 
Equipment
Complete tool set
New brushes, Air blower, 
 and Spray
Digital voltmeter, megger, 
 clamp ammeter
Fine cloth and brushes 
 for cleaning purposes
Work to be carried out
stator
Measure insulation resistance
Carry out hydrostatic 
 test.
Replace bushing gaskets.
Dismantle and re-seal of 
 bushing trough.
Inspect winding and end 
 turns.
Check slot wedges for tight 
 seating.
Inspect winding conductors 
 in slots.
Check condition and 
 compression of core.
Inspect ventilating slots 
 in core.
Check clamping flanges and 
 fingers for tight seating.
Dismantle bushing plates 
 placement of gaskets.
Dismantle stator front 
 sections and end shields replacement of all gaskets.
Rotor
Dismantle rotor.
Measure insulation resistance
Inspect bearing surfaces 
 and shaft collars.
Check ventilating duct for 
 slip ring leads .
Clean and inspect of 
 slipping.
Inspect rotor and slip ring 
 fans
Inspect slip ring brushes.
Inspect brush holders.
Check rotor wedges end 
 bells and slip rings for tight seating .
Inspect gas outlet ducts.
Check coupling flange and 
 coupling at turbine and exciter ends .
Check alignment.
Shaft Seals
Check oil tightness
Check sliding faces of seal 
 rings seal guides and seal housings.
Inspect seal ring contact 
 faces.
Inspect oil level controllers 
 and alarm switches.
Check thermocouples
Hydrogen system
Check H2 pressure reducers.
Inspect diaphragm and 
 selector valves.
Inspect pressure gauge stop 
 valves.
Check gas pressure breaker.
Check gas drier and clean if required .
Replace drier gel filling.
Check performance of 
 liquid level alarm switches.
Inspect CO2 flash tank (marl them 
 fill if required ).
Check high-pressure valves.
Check thermal gas analyzer.
Check performance of 
 pressure gauges.
Check thermometers.
Check rod type thermostats.
Inspect dry-type filters and 
 replace if required.
Exciter Set
Measure insulation resistance
Check bearing insulation.
Overhaul communal 
 (undercutting of mica if reqd).
Clean frames.
Inspect magnet frame and arm lure 
 windings and clean if required.
Check slot wedges and bind bands.
Inspect couplings.
Check alignment.
Inspect air filters and 
 clean if required.
Inspect air ducts and clean if required
Check brush assembly and adjust 
 neutral axis. Inspect brush holders.
Inspect brushes.
Check field rheostat and 
 voltage regulator.
Regrease of antifriction bearings 
 (grease renewal if reqd)
Coolers
Inspect H2 coolers on water 
 side and clean if reqd .
Inspect H2 cooler gaskets 
 ( on air side )
Replace H2 cooler 
 gaskets
Inspect surface protection 
 of water boxes and renewal , if required
Withdraw H2 coolers and clean it on gas side.
Lisp of seal oil coolers on water 
 side and clean if required .
Inspect seal oil cooler 
 gaskets.
Replace seal oil cooler 
 gaskets.
Clean seal oil coolers on 
 oil side .
Clean vents.
Bearings
Inspect bearing insulation
Through cleaning of bearing .
Inspect bearing sleeves
Inspect oil pipes
Check spherical seats
Inspect oil grooves and 
 pipes for oil jacking
Perform check of oil jacking 
 pump
Inspect pressure control 
 valve and non-return valve
Inspect drains of oil 
 vapour extractor and pressure breaker pipes
Inspect oil vapour 
 extractor fan
Clean and inspect 
 non-return valve of oil vapour extractor
Check oil pipes
Seal Oil Supply System
Check seal oil pumps incl. 
 motors
Inspect oil supply pressure 
 controller overflow valve and relief valve.
Inspect seal oil pressure 
 controller.
Check oil filters and 
 cleaning if required.
Check automatic seal oil 
 control system.
Inspect isolating and 
 non-return valves.
Check performance of 
 solenoid valves.
Check pressure gauge stop 
 valves.
Vent and check pressure 
 gauges check contact settings.
Check performance of 
 pressure gauges.
Check thermometers.
